decisions.statement: A note is written only where a live read at the moment of writing shows no note.
A transaction Monarch does not report on the day asked for is refused rather than written blind.
A caller says which transaction was passed over and why.
A note written has the tag saying a machine wrote that note.
Setting tags states the whole list.
The standing tags are carried rather than replaced.

definition: the note and the tags written back onto a Monarch transaction
